Sacred Grove
35% of base mana
Instant cast3 min cooldown
Create a Sacred Grove in a 15 yd radius around you for 16 sec, instantly healing all nearby party and raid members for 2002+0+AP*1.

While active, up to 12 allies in the grove receive 25% increased healing, and regain 3% of their missing health, Rage, and mana every 2 sec.
